Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1168
Claimant:
Denise Carpenter
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
February 2, 2025
Claim oepned after a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving two insured vehicles. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
March 8, 2025
Reviewed the police report and statements from two witnesses, who both describe the impact in the same way the
claimant did. Photos taken at the scene are consistent with that account.
March 10, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the sequence of events and placed the claimant in the vehicle at the time
of the collision, which police also noted.
May 23, 2025
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. The damage pattern lines up with the impact described, and no older damage was
visible in the affected area.
May 26, 2025
Checked the policy records. The driver involved is named on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage
predates the coverage start.
May 30, 2025
Received the medical summary showing neck and back strain. The injury type and severity fit the force of the collision
as reported.
June 6, 2025
Attorney provided the treatment records. Care followed a typical course and eased off as the claimant improved, with
no unusual gaps or add-on procedures.
August 14, 2025
The medical history includes a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved completely with no
ongoing complaints noted in the records.
August 21, 2025
Took a recorded follow-up call with the claimant. The account matched what was given at first notice, with the same
details repeated without change.
August 29, 2025
Reviewed the prior-damage check and vehicle history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
September 14, 2025
Bsaed on the police report, witness statements, photos, vehicle inspection, and medical records, the claim is
consistent throughout and is moving forward for standard evaluation through counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
